findings.problem: The scope-conflict query treats every blocked slice as a quarantined active slice. Slices waiting for a dependency start blocked before they have ever received a lease. If a dependent child and its ready parent own overlapping paths, the waiting child prevents its parent from being claimed, so the graph cannot advance.
findings.repair: Distinguish dependency-waiting from worker-reported BLOCKED/UNKNOWN quarantine in persisted state and in both stores. Only unresolved work that actually acquired a lease may hold a capacity slot or quarantine a scope. Test an overlapping parent-child dependency in memory and PostgreSQL, including cross-mission conflicts.

findings.problem: Repository scope conflicts compare the submitted owner/repo string case-sensitively. GitHub repository names are case-insensitive, so two missions targeting the same repository under different casing can claim overlapping scopes concurrently.
findings.repair: Use one canonical repository identity for conflicts, preferably the resolved GitHub repository ID once the App is connected; for this bounded slice normalize owner/repo case consistently at submission and comparison. Add a two-mission mixed-case overlap test.

findings.problem: After a candidate arrives, normal dependency-waiting children make SQL report the mission unknown and memory report it blocked. This conflates planned dependency wait with a real BLOCKED/UNKNOWN outcome and misstates owner-visible progress.
findings.repair: Derive mission status from semantically distinct waiting and quarantined states. A parent candidate awaiting independent verification should leave the mission awaiting_verification unless a real BLOCKED/UNKNOWN outcome exists. Update HTTP and store assertions.

findings.problem: The expired-lease transition is only called directly by tests. The running service has no startup, periodic, or claim-time reconciliation call. After a worker disappears, an expired lease remains persisted as running without an UNKNOWN event indefinitely; its callback is fenced but documented recovery state is not produced.
findings.repair: Add a bounded durable expiry sweep at startup and during operation, or before every claim, with a restart regression test. Preserve budget, slot, and scope quarantine and do not replay ambiguous effects.

positive_evidence: All 21 files matched the frozen local manifest when reviewed; controller reported npm ci, typecheck, 18/18 tests, build, validate, and diff check exit 0
Owner mission writes retain session and cloud Origin/Host checks; worker routes use a separate bootstrap bearer and fenced lease/capability pair
Builder callbacks stop at awaiting_verification; integrate throws and no verifier endpoint can turn arbitrary evidence strings into certification
Expired/unknown work is intended to retain reservation and capacity/scope quarantine; current deterministic store tests cover that transition when explicitly invoked
qualification: Review is for the frozen 21-file working-tree candidate only. Real multi-connection PostgreSQL proof was pending at review time. Any source normalization or repair changes the candidate and requires a new manifest, deterministic gates, and independent re-review. This is not live worker, product, or finish-contract acceptance.
